newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,379 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,379 contracts.

text.p: The Chicago Board of Trade Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totalled 1,379 contracts compared with 516 overnight Tuesday, according to the CBOT.
There were 54 wheat, 381 corn, 795 soybean, 71 soymeal, 49 soyoil, four oat, eight wheat calls, two corn puts, nine soybean calls and six soybean puts.
In overnight trading, wheat was one cent higher to 1/4 cent lower, corn was 1/2 to one cent lower and soybeans were 3/4 cent lower to 1/4 cent higher.
